description: Take voters off a DRAFT election in the connected account, by email address or by unit. A voter goes when their email is named, or when every unit they hold is named, so nobody loses a unit by accident; the contact book is not touched. Returns how many were taken off and how many of those named are not on the list, never the rows, and the updated price.

emails.description: Email addresses of the voters to take off.

units.description: Units, lots or address labels whose voters to take off, e.g. "Unit 4B".

name: remove_voters
title: Take voters off a draft election
